claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two Float32 modifier helpers called by MatchMisc.ApplyDamage before its CriticalCheck split are closed together. MatchMisc.GetSkillSlotDamageMdf (0x0600494B) has parameters named slot and sd and an exact 132-byte body: raw slot -1 returns 1.0; otherwise it calls SkillSlotDataMan.GetSkillSlotData(slot), returns 1.0 when slotDamageMdf is zero, computes slotStrength - sd.primarySkillStrength, returns 1.0 when that difference is not positive, then maps slotDamageMdf/difference branches exactly to 1.2 or 1.5 for raw mode 1, 1.1 or 1.2 for raw mode 2, and 1.0 otherwise. MatchMisc.GetExchangeOfStrikingDamageMdf (0x0600494C) has Int32 parameters atk_pl_idx and def_pl_idx and an exact 239-byte body: it returns 1.0 if either Player is absent, computes attacker.HP/65535.0 and defender.HP/65535.0 plus Abs(their difference), returns 1.0 when that difference is below 0.2, then selects one of two directional threshold ladders at 0.8, 0.6 and 0.4. The local2 >= local3 path returns 0.25, 0.33000001311302185, 0.5, or 0.800000011920929; the local2 < local3 path returns 4.0, 3.0, 2.0, or 1.2000000476837158. FACT-0020 pins the first helper at ApplyDamage IL+0x0097 and the second at IL+0x00B9 under the already-recorded raw slot-24/25 branch.
